# Junk Away We Go Demolition Inc.

> Family-owned junk removal and light demolition in Poway and San Diego County. Transparent load-tier pricing with labor, dump fees, and taxes included. Owner: Matt Geiss. CA License #1128050.

## Company

- Name: Junk Away We Go Demolition Inc.
- Owner: Matt Geiss
- Address: 13507 Calle Colina, Poway, CA 92064
- Phone: 760-473-3973
- Email: Junkawaywego@gmail.com
- License: CA #1128050
- Service area: Poway, San Diego, Escondido, Oceanside, San Marcos, Ramona, Rancho Bernardo, Carlsbad, Vista

## Services

- Residential junk removal (furniture, appliances, garage cleanouts, estate cleanouts)
- Commercial junk removal (office e-waste, retail fixtures, storage units)
- Light demolition (sheds, decks, hot tubs, interior walls, shed teardowns)
- Eco-friendly disposal and recycling

## Pricing (load-tier based, 12x8x5 ft dump trailer)

- Minimum load: starts at $125
- 1/4 load: starts at $175
- 1/2 load: starts at $350
- 3/4 load: starts at $525
- Full load: starts at $699

Every price includes labor, dump fees, and taxes. No truck roll fee. No hidden surcharges.

## Surcharges

- Appliances: +$30 each
- Tires, construction debris, electronics/e-waste: priced case by case
- Stairs, tight access, disassembly, pianos, hot tubs: effort-based add
- Same-day or rush jobs: percentage premium

## What we don't accept

- Paint, chemicals, pesticides in large quantities
- Propane tanks and fuel
- Pressure-treated wood in bulk
